integrity: The proof supplies a global parametric theorem and exact equality cases. Finite software checks are supplementary, and the claim is not an operational earthquake early-warning calibration. Scholarly priority is provisional; no external independent review has been completed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional circular fault corridor, uniformly distributed source, three equal timely detection arcs of length no more than one-third circumference, independent identical Bernoulli reports conditional on coverage and no false positives. No correlated colocated station failures, site/installation constraints, heterogeneous velocities, realistic three-dimensional propagation or field-calibrated decision probabilities.
title: Three-receiver confirmation transitions on an idealized circular seismic fault
